svg.text: Reference-aligned construction sheet • prototype-coordinate baseline • three independent live text faces
Facade + canopy + lighting + projected marquee assembly
Editable letterboards and named geometric surfaces
Positive Z points toward the viewer / street
TEXT FACES / editable at runtime, not baked into the mesh
Active text area: U = 0.053–0.947 of face length | Y = 3.82–4.89 | height 1.07 U
KEEP TEXT AND BULB ARRAYS LIVE. DO NOT BAKE.
Values reproduce the current standalone prototype’s construction coordinates, not measured real-world dimensions.
Use this for modeling, rigging, object naming and camera alignment. Reconcile geometry against the cleaned image during approval.
